cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(micropython_staticlib C)

# The micropython_embed directory is generated by running:
#   make -f micropython_embed.mk
# from this directory before running cmake.
set(EMBED_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/micropython_embed)

if(NOT EXISTS ${EMBED_DIR})
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "The micropython_embed directory does not exist.\n"
        "Generate it first by running:\n"
        "  make -f micropython_embed.mk\n"
        "from the examples/embedding-staticlib directory.")
endif()

# Gather all MicroPython embed source files (py, extmod, shared, port).
file(GLOB_RECURSE MICROPYTHON_EMBED_SOURCES
    ${EMBED_DIR}/*/*.c
    ${EMBED_DIR}/*/*/*.c
)

# Build MicroPython as a static library.
add_library(micropython STATIC ${MICROPYTHON_EMBED_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(micropython PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${EMBED_DIR}
    ${EMBED_DIR}/port
)

target_compile_options(micropython PRIVATE
    -Wall
    -Wno-unused-function
)

# Link against the system math library (required by the math module).
target_link_libraries(micropython PUBLIC m)

# Build the example application that embeds MicroPython.
add_executable(embed_staticlib main.c)

target_include_directories(embed_staticlib PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${EMBED_DIR}
    ${EMBED_DIR}/port
)

target_compile_options(embed_staticlib PRIVATE
    -Wall
)

target_link_libraries(embed_staticlib micropython)
